content.jointProblem: Can an unsupervised, site-specific baseline learned only from benign Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP traffic detect behaviour drift accurately enough and explain alerts plainly enough for a plant manager, while running on the ProtoSense appliance within its latency budget? Any detection or false-positive performance is a hypothesis to be tested on ArmaturaSec's own archives and hardware bench, not a promised result.

rationale.text: The researcher has already built and evaluated unsupervised Modbus anomaly detection trained exclusively on benign traffic, which matches the company's no-labels setting.

sources.quote: Anomalies are identified by measuring reconstruction error against learned normal patterns, without requiring labelled attack data

rationale.text: His comparative SCADA IDS study evaluates detection architectures on detection accuracy, latency, resource consumption and concept drift, the operational dimensions the company must balance.

sources.quote: Performance is measured in terms of detection accuracy, latency, resource consumption, and adaptability to concept drift

rationale.text: He has worked on model compression for on-device detection on memory- and power-constrained hardware, which maps onto running inference inside an OT appliance.

sources.quote: reduce model size by up to 94% relative to full-precision baselines, while preserving detection accuracy above 90%

rationale.text: His threat-modelling work on smart building controllers gives him domain grounding relevant to the BACnet side of the company's ProtoSense module.

sources.quote: applies a structured threat modelling methodology—adapted from STRIDE and augmented with ICS-specific threat categories—to a representative smart building controller architecture

rationale.text: He contributes to an ICS monitoring project targeting Modbus and other factory protocols in Serbian manufacturing facilities.

sources.quote: The platform targets Modbus, PROFINET, and EtherNet/IP protocol stacks commonly found in Serbian manufacturing facilities

rationale.text: He is explicitly open to both joint projects and industrial PhD supervision, so either collaboration route is available.

sources.quote: He is open to supervising industrial PhD students and engaging in joint research projects

constraints.text: The method must learn a site-specific baseline from benign traffic alone, because the company holds no confirmed malicious captures.

sources.quote: we have zero examples of malicious traffic and supervised classifiers are useless to us

constraints.text: Output must be explainable to non-specialist plant staff in plain language, not just a numeric anomaly score.

sources.quote: We need a method that works with no attack examples and that we can explain to a plant manager in plain language

constraints.text: False positives must stay low enough that clients do not disable alerting, as happened with the earlier supervised classifier.

sources.quote: it flagged so many false positives in real deployments that clients started switching the alerts off

constraints.text: Inference must run on the appliance without affecting packet forwarding latency; the dedicated security processor is only planned, not yet shipped.

sources.quote: a fifth hardware variant in late 2025 with a dedicated security processor to support on-device anomaly detection without affecting packet forwarding latency

constraints.text: Work depends on NDA-protected traffic archives, firmware codebase and bench access, with only part-time engineering capacity.

sources.quote: We can dedicate one to two engineers part-time to a collaborative project, with access to our traffic archives, our hardware bench, and our existing firmware codebase under NDA.

constraints.text: Models must fit resource-constrained industrial deployment targets rather than only desktop or server hardware.

sources.quote: offering practical guidance for deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments

risks: The Modbus autoencoder results were obtained on a synthetic dataset from a PLC testbed; transfer to ArmaturaSec's real multi-site archives is unproven and must be the first experiment.
Evidence on BACnet is threat modelling of building controllers, not traffic-based anomaly detection, so the BACnet/IP half of ProtoSense carries a larger methodological gap.
With no confirmed attacks in the archives, true detection performance cannot be measured directly; evaluation would rely on red-team or bench-injected attacks whose realism is unknown.
Public ICS datasets previously caused false positives in real deployments, signalling a domain-shift problem that a purely benign-trained baseline may not solve.
The researcher's availability is recorded as unknown, and the company offers only one to two part-time engineers, so scheduling and supervision capacity are uncertain.
Turning reconstruction-error or drift signals into plain-language explanations that satisfy plant managers and possibly regulators is unresolved by the cited work.
The on-device latency target depends on a hardware variant planned for late 2025, so early results would run on the existing bench rather than the target platform.
questions: What is Professor Đukić's actual availability and time commitment per month for this collaboration?
Which protocol should be tackled first, Modbus TCP or BACnet/IP, and how are the three years of captures split between them?
Do any captures contain suspected or red-team incidents that could serve as a held-out evaluation set, even if unconfirmed?
Can attack traffic be generated on the hardware-in-the-loop bench with physical PLC simulators to validate detection?
What is the hard latency budget per packet and memory budget on the current appliance, and does the fifth hardware variant timeline align with the project?
What NDA and data-handling terms apply to the traffic archives and firmware codebase?
Which format does the company prefer first: a joint project or an industrial PhD co-supervision?
What level of explanation and reporting do the end clients or any regulator require from an alert?
